title: Another Favor
html:
Quest Giver: Kentucky Jim

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: While still in Dew Valley, bask in the glow of self-satisfaction after helping Liza Beth. Then realize Kentucky Jim is trying to catch your attention.

Quest Reward: None listed

Return to: Kentucky Jim

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The Hermit's Hoop

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: While still in Dew Valley, bask in the glow of self-satisfaction after helping Liza Beth. Then realize Kentucky Jim is trying to catch your attention.

Offer:

Thanks again for buying that book for me. It will totally help my studies!

Now that we're bestest friends forever, I want to give you my help queue ticket. I'm totally sure it's a lower number than yours, since I've been standing in line for so long, so you'll totally be in a better position in the queue! Besides, you've already given me your ticket, so it's totally the least I could do. Here's ticket #196,608 for you.

I forgot...what was your original ticket number? Hm. It says #54,000,601.... *Sigh* Maybe swapping tickets wasn't my best idea ever. Oh, well. Live and learn.

Turn-in:

Hey, they call me Kentucky Jim. 'They' who? Well, my mom, my Uncle James...look, never mind that. I heard you did a favor for Liza Beth or Sally Mae or whatever her name is, and then she swapped tickets with you.

I'll tell you what...my ticket number is #2814. If you do *me* a favor, I'll trade you my ticket for yours--then you'll be ahead of me in the queue.

Let me know if you want to do me that favor. And hurry up...I have to go to the orthodontist soon.

Objectives:

  • Ticket #196,608 ×1

Level range: 1–5
